## Our expertise
140 years of experience in creating groundbreaking glass solutions evolved into our commitment to material innovations. Discover how SCHOTT uses this unique know-how and the latest technology to set new standards in a wide range of industries. 
[ Discover our expertise ](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/expertise)

## Careers at SCHOTT
Learn about the career opportunities and benefits waiting for you at one of the leading international technology groups in the areas of specialty glass, glass-ceramics and material solutions. At SCHOTT everybody can make a difference. Because together, we pioneer groundbreaking glass and material innovations, fueling science and inspiring progress.

## SCHOTT in the media
22 January 2026
glass online
### SCHOTT revenues remain stable despite challenging market conditions
SCHOTT closed fiscal year 2024/2025 with a stable sales performance of EUR 2.83 billion despite a demanding global business environment of uncertainty and weaker demand. (…) By integrating QSIL GmbH Quarzschmelze Ilmenau following its acquisition, SCHOTT reinforced its quartz glass capabilities, which are especially relevant for chip and wafer production processes in the semiconductor industry.

But Schott, a Germany-based optics company that manufactures reflective waveguide-equipped lens technology, sees possibilities. Rudiger Sprengard, head of augmented reality for Schott, says a larger display area of 60 degrees is possible.

# Our purpose
Pioneering the impossible.
Because at SCHOTT we believe that shared responsibility can release the energy to achieve the impossible. Working closely together with our customers we are determined to make a real difference in the world – yesterday, today and tomorrow.
[Watch our story](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/company/our-purpose#BrandImageFilm)
## Where others say no, 
## we say yes.
The seemingly impossible solution-finding missions we get to go on as a global technology company awaken our ambition, our curiosity and our perseverance. We embrace the visionary ideas of our customers; overcome the physical boundaries of the materials we work with and take on our social and environmental responsibilities in today’s world. Whatever challenges the future might hold, we can’t wait to come up with innovative solutions and turn visions into reality.

### mRNA storage solutions
Can drug containment solutions and polymer syringes withstand temperatures of up to -80°C? Yes! SCHOTT vials made of glass and polymer meet the highly demanding transportation and storage needs for mRNA applications so they can be safely distributed to patients.

### Extremely Large Telescope
Can glass-ceramic contribute to an unprecedented window into distant galaxies? Yes! Made with SCHOTT ZERODUR® glass-ceramic, the European Southern Observatory’s Extremely Large Telescope’s segmented primary mirror is 39 meters in diameter and is widely expected to break new ground in space exploration.

### mRNA storage solutions
Can drug containment solutions and polymer syringes withstand temperatures of up to -80°C? Yes! SCHOTT vials made of glass and polymer meet the highly demanding transportation and storage needs for mRNA applications so they can be safely distributed to patients.
[Discover more](https://www.schott-pharma.com/en/solutions/perfect-fit/storage-of-mrna-drugs)
**Pioneering material solutions**  
  
As a global material technology group SCHOTT is constantly exploring unique and innovative ways to make a difference for multiple businesses and industries. Therefore, we push the technological limits of glass and apply cutting-edge methods to design new or evaluate ‘adjacent’ materials and technologies that perfectly complement our portfolio. This approach opens up new possibilities for our customers and enables life-changing innovations.

## Our unique contribution
SCHOTT has more than 140 years of experience in reinventing glass to make life better. This fascination for specialty glass has evolved into a commitment to material innovation. Our customers have access to our holistic tech-material expertise and unique know-how in processing and technology. From our founders to all of our 17.400 employees today, SCHOTT is driven by a passion for innovative products and their possibility to change the world.
##### Turning ideas into reality
As a global market leader, we empower our customers to stand out within their business segments and dare to think big. The highly skilled and dedicated people working at SCHOTT turn bold ideas into reality. Together, we pioneer groundbreaking glass and material innovations, fueling science and inspiring progress. 
[ Discover more ](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/expertise)
![Man wearing safety goggles working on a machine in a production facility](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/04b554d443434407be41b151688ea513?t=OnExW720)
##### Partnership & collaboration
We believe in the value and success of close collaboration and a dynamic exchange of different perspectives and experiences. Working in diverse and multidisciplinary teams increases efficiency and creativity. This also applies to the relationships we build with our customers. We foster long-term partnerships and work hand in hand from the very beginning to develop forward-thinking solutions. 
[ Learn more ](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/references)
![Cobot positioning a Glaswafer into a laser processing machine](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/4fa583912d1d444a96986898f1e43f53?t=OnExW720)
##### Future-ready material solutions
The aim of our work is to create durable, future-ready solutions that are produced as sustainable and cost-effective as possible. To make our production energy-efficient, we drive digitalization and act responsible. Saving energy, switching to green electricity and developing new technologies are unquestionable measures for environmental protection. And as a foundation company, both social and environmental responsibility have been part of our culture since day one. 
[ Discover more ](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/sustainability)

## The SCHOTT values
### Act responsibly
A deep belief in responsibility and accountability for one's own actions. Taking care of the health of our employees and the environment.
### Respect others
Respect, value and trust each other without any prejudice and acknowledging local culture. Foster diversity and equal opportunity. Bring different opinions, mindsets and expertise together as a team.
### Create value
Create value encouraging people to develop their full potential. Be entrepreneurial, quality-driven and solution-oriented. Make use of long expertise to create relevant and sustainable solutions in close cooperation.
### Drive innovation
Produce new and creative solutions. Be open and continuously improve processes and dare to explore new ideas.

# Dr. Andrea Frenzel
Member of the Management Board
## About
Andrea Frenzel joined the Management Board in April 2023. She is responsible for the Business Units Advanced Optics, Electronic Packaging, and Lighting and Imaging as well as for the Corporate Functions Technical Services, Operational Technology, Operational Excellence, and Environment, Health & Safety.
Andrea Frenzel was born in Göttingen, Germany, in 1970. She studied Chemistry at the University of Göttingen, where she received her diploma followed by a Doctorate Degree in Inorganic Chemistry in 1995. From 1996 to 1997, she was a PostDoc at the University of Wisconsin in Madison, USA.
![Portrait of Dr. Andrea Frenzel, Member of the Management Board SCHOTT AG](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/14993f62595541ce8a981b233390318d?t=OnExW690)

# SCHOTT Lukácsháza
One of SCHOTT’s key operational hubs in Europe is located in the Hungarian town of Lukácsháza. Since 1993 it has been a key focal point for the production of pharmaceutical packaging, and continues to expand its operations to keep SCHOTT at the forefront of global glass technology.
## A key European center of excellence for SCHOTT
When SCHOTT established its operations in Lukácsháza in 1993, it was the start of developing a key hub for the production of pharmaceutical packaging. The manufacture of ampoules and vials began in 1995, with state-of-the-art production machinery installed, with the production of cartridges beginning in 2002. As the facilities were continually upgraded and developed, the premises grew to cover 26,000 square meters. Today, Lukácsháza is proud to be SCHOTT’s European center of excellence for ampoules.
![1995](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/6edb6a5dbee54ad0bd844c8d9efb4020?t=OnExW120)
1995
was the year the Lukácsháza plant opened.
![630](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/459bdc6b0cba4c318f2addfb9b27275c?t=OnExW120)
630
employees work at SCHOTT Lukácsháza.
![26,000 m2](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/52aa7bbaf73f4531a7f54d2e904fac8f?t=OnExW120)
26,000 m2
is the area covered by the Lukácsháza site.
## What we offer
### Markets and Applications
Since its establishment in 1993, the Lukácsháza plant has become one of Europe’s foremost centers for pharmaceutical packaging. This growth has been driven by the continuing high demand for the industry-leading product quality synonymous with SCHOTT. Clients do not just include Hungarian customers, but leading pharmaceutical companies around the globe.
The ampoules and cartridges produced here offer the highest quality for a range of applications, delivering robust, chemically resistant protection for medicines used in all kinds of fields, from the insulin treatment of diabetes to pre-filled syringes for the emergency services.
![Production line for pharmaceutical glass ampoules](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/702421a074434ddca141ba3e1e26a94d?t=OnExW690)
### Products
Approximately 2.2 billion vials (1-30ml), ampoules (1-30ml), and cartridges are produced every year at Lukácsháza, with each one going through a rigorous process to ensure quality control. After shaping, the products go through a measuring line then, after a tension relieving step, they arrive at the site’s neighboring packaging premises, where cosmetic compliance is carried out in accordance with international standards and the demanding requirements of SCHOTT customers. After packaging, a thorough inspection of critical dimensions is undertaken on every production line, using highly advanced camera systems.
![Two clear glass ampoules](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/6e9ba295b4f24c79b2c703acf31947eb?t=OnExW690)

## About the region
### A rural location for a key operation
The Lukácsháza site is located at the western tip of Hungary, close to the border with Austria. While apparently remote, surrounded by hills and vineyards, it benefits from good transport links, lying 13 km north of Szombathely, 7 km south of Kőszeg, and flanked by the Gyöngyös stream and highway 87. The setting is characterized by a sub-alpine climate, clean air and beautiful scenery.

# SCHOTT in Mumbai
SCHOTT Glass India Pvt. Ltd was incorporated in 1998 with a tubing production site in Jambusar, Gujarat and a sales office in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
## SCHOTT’s Mumbai location at a glance
Since 1998, SCHOTT has been serving Indian customers with its wide range of specialty glass with applications ranging from Health and Medical sector to Automotives, from Defense and Space to Home Appliances, from Architectural sector to Food Display. All such special glass application requirements are supported by the sales team at SCHOTT Mumbai and accomplished through products available in SCHOTT’s extensive portfolio.
![Expertise](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/dd0af4ab78a5456e991fc6ee3b521271?v=84ca1706&t=OnExW120)
Expertise
25 years in India and over 140 years globally.
![Brands](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/ddce0286c4c94a28aef192d3b89f6269?v=590539d3&t=OnExW120)
Brands
FIOLAX®, PYRAN®, ZERODUR®, ROBAX® - benchmarks of excellence in their respective industries.

## What we offer
### Markets and applications
SCHOTT is present in India across a number of markets thanks to the renowned versatility of its product portfolio. These products offer major advantages for a variety of markets, including electronic and pharmaceutical packaging, home technology, lighting and imaging, glass tubing, and advanced optics, continuing to push industry standards even higher. 
![Indian Man on mobile](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/95b902c183144f3aa8f93a66a8479539?v=a5dd9d50&_o=True)
### Products
SCHOTT is well known in India for its highly advanced, chemically resistant, and mechanically robust glass tubing for parenteral primary packaging. These tubings are produced at the pharmaceutical tubing plant in [Jambusar, Gujarat, India](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/company/regions-and-locations/jambusar).   
  
SCHOTT produces specialty glass ranging from touch cover and foldable glass for mobile phones, glass powders for dental and electronic applications, optical glass, glass ceramics for space, astronomy applications, flat glass for kitchen appliances and food display, special glass ceramics for induction cooking to specialty tubing for automotive head lamps and other glass to metal seal applications.  
  
Some of SCHOTT’s brands like [FIOLAX®](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/products/pharmaceutical-tubing-p1000372) and [ZERODUR®](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/products/zerodur-p1000269) are gold standards in their respective Industries. 
![	 Close-up of glass tubes and ampoules with clear and amber liquid on a reflective surface.](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/4ba5f253a8824d27954b36e176abecdf?v=22c0bedd&t=OnExW690)
### SCHOTT FIOLAX® scholarship program
SCHOTT, as a foundation company, is committed to advancing science and nurturing young talents, particularly in the healthcare sector. Since 2014, FIOLAX® scholarship program has supported exceptional pharmacy students in India. Each year, few of these students are awarded for their outstanding academic achievements, industry knowledge, and personal aspirations.  
  
This initiative reflects SCHOTT's dedication in empowering the future leaders of the pharmaceutical industry and fostering innovation in healthcare. 
![Award winners and organizers at a SCHOTT ceremony, holding certificates in a festive setting.](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/63ae33f822a541dbbeb757ad5d266949?v=0d93ade6&t=OnExW690)

## About the region
### Mumbai: The financial capital of India
Mumbai was made famous by the well-known author Suketu Mehta when he first coined the term Maximum City for this bustling metropolis. Mumbai is a veritable hot pot of the varied culture and diversity of India. Mumbai has an entrepreneurial spirit and is the financial hub for India. SCHOTT chose Mumbai for its sales office due to its easy connectivity to different parts of India thus enabling the sales team to be close to the customers. 
![	 Gateway of India in Mumbai, surrounded by boats, with the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel in the background.](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/5a7dace6d6eb4c4eaefcba8a9d8aed53?v=f0fb93b8&t=OnExW690)
The Gateway of India, build in 1911 is a prominent tourist attraction and a symbol of Mumbai's history and culture.

# SCHOTT Rye Brook, NY
While the origins of SCHOTT lie in Europe, its presence in the US market continues to grow, and its corporate headquarters for North America has been situated in New York state for 58 years now. A recent move to Rye Brook, New York opens a new chapter for SCHOTT’s operations in the US.
## SCHOTT’s new center for North American operations
In early 2021, SCHOTT North America moved its corporate office a few miles across Westchester County from its long-time home of Elmsford to Rye Brook. The Rye Brook site is a recently renovated six-building complex set in 25 acres of land with extensive amenities, and is SCHOTT’s base of operations for HR, Legal, IT, Marketing and Communications, and Financial Services for the whole North American region. SCHOTT's Tubing business unit also operates out of Rye Brook, supplying technical and pharmaceutical tubing for markets across the Americas.

## What we offer
### Markets and Applications
As the administrative hub for SCHOTT’s operations across North America, the Rye Brook office is highly knowledgeable about the wide range of markets and applications served by SCHOTT products. SCHOTT’s Tubing business unit in Rye Brook focuses on tailor-made products that continue to prove indispensable in fields such as pharmaceuticals, industrial and environmental technology, and electronics. Our reputation for innovation is relied upon by our network of customers and commercial partners, who look to us to tailor glass tubing solutions for their specific needs.
![Series of clear glass tubes arranged in a wave pattern](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/8861ab9df42c41e38885b75b3e9f52ad?t=OnExW690)
### Products
The product portfolio of SCHOTT Tubing includes glass tubes, rods, and profiles made from more than 60 types of specialty glass. One product line that’s unique to the North American market is KIMAX® acid waste and vent systems, which is made of borosilicate glass piping and features exceptional chemical resistance and mechanical strength. KIMAX® sets new standards for corrosive waste systems while keeping the components sustainable, user-friendly, and easy to assemble.
![Section of KIMAX® clear glass tubing with metal joint](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/075c330e23bd4b908636e75e0c1ea49a?t=OnExW690)

## About the region
### A village atmosphere close to the city
A suburb of the greater New York City area, the town of Rye Brook is known as one of the best places to live in the state. While it offers residents plenty of amenities such as restaurants, coffee shops, and parks, it feels removed from the neighboring big city – indeed, Rye Brook has been part of the Tree City USA project for over 14 years, which aims to add green spaces to suburban areas. SCHOTT’s Rye Brook HQ is just five minutes’ drive from the Westchester County Airport and around 35 miles north of New York City, making it extremely well-connected, as well as being a great place to live and work.

# SCHOTT Shanghai
The Chinese market continues to offer exciting new opportunities for many industries, and SCHOTT has been investing in the country for nearly 20 years. As sales office, SCHOTT’s plant in Shanghai is responsible for marketing, business development and administrative management in China.
## SCHOTT’s key business base in China
SCHOTT (Shanghai) Precision Materials & Equipment International Trading Co. Ltd was established in 2002, setting down a lasting base for the company’s sales operations in China. The city of nearly 25 million people continues to be the center of SCHOTT’s marketing, management, and business development in China. SCHOTT’s Shanghai headquarters combines a customer-oriented working style with a family-friendly philosophy, offering premium service alongside an outstanding range of benefits and flexible working advantages for its employees.

## What we offer
### Markets and Applications
SCHOTT’s expanding operations in Shanghai have increased the company’s presence across a number of markets thanks to the renowned versatility of our product portfolio. These products include electronic packaging, pharma drug containment and delivery solutions, home technology, lighting and imaging, glass tubing, and advanced optics, continuing to push industry standards even higher.
![A modern kitchen in natural colors](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/5cc9cedd79b845bba2dc93baf37826a7?t=OnExW690)
### Products
Many of the products SCHOTT specializes in are manufactured in China. These include pharma drug containment and delivery solutions to safely store and administer medications, as well as semiconductor packaging for the electronics and telecommunications industries. Furthermore, touch screens and components for advanced automotive systems and aviation technology, plus glasses used in lighting and imaging technology that facilitate breakthroughs in life sciences and medicine, are also produced here. The responsible sales office is located in Shanghai.
![Female scientist inspecting a glass vial in a laboratory](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/49dd84e134b9455b818ed180c47df29d?t=OnExW690)

## About the region
### The economic epicenter of the new China
As the leading business hub of this fast-evolving country, Shanghai has been described as the “showpiece” city of China’s booming economy. In 2018, Shanghai hosted the China International Import Expo (CIIE), the world’s first import-themed national-level expo, which reflected the city’s strong focus on developing commerce. Shanghai is also developing a reputation as a cultural center, and regularly hosts international events such as Shanghai Fashion Week and the Chinese Formula One Grand Prix. That ties in with the city’s rich history, represented by historic buildings such as the City God Temple, Yu Garden and the China Pavilion.

# SCHOTT Suzhou
The city of Suzhou in eastern China’s Jiangsu province is home to SCHOTT Glass Technologies (Suzhou). The main focus of the plant is the supply of glass-ceramics and toughened glass for the kitchen and household appliance industries, as well as glass for pharmaceutical packaging.  

## Driving innovation at SCHOTT in Suzhou
As a leading manufacturing hub for glass-ceramics and processed flat glasses for home and kitchen appliances, the SCHOTT site in Suzhou provides high-quality solutions for a range of technologies. It offers versatile, state-of-the-art specialty glass products that enable its customers to set new standards in design and product innovation. 
Besides supplying the Home and Living sectors, Suzhou also plays an important role in the healthcare industry, producing high-quality pharma drug containment and delivery solutions for the Chinese pharmaceutical market. The Suzhou plant is also the location of the Application Development Center, as well as the sales team, which ensures a close relationship with customers to meet their specific needs.

## What we offer
### Markets and Applications
SCHOTT Suzhou is a leading supplier of glass-ceramics and tempered glasses for the kitchen and the household appliances industry – and much more. Whether their commercial partners require stylish, bespoke components for home appliances or are looking to make bold statements in the kitchen or house, all products combine reliability with design creativity.
In addition, SCHOTT Pharma is a highly trusted partner for the pharmaceutical industry, which relies on pharma drug containment and delivery solutions to protect life-saving medications.
![ SCHOTT CERAN® glass-ceramic cooktop panel with red and blue display](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/0556b1eee0604eda9bfc624f3b0cf3ac?t=OnExW690)
### Products
The Suzhou plant is a key center for the production of SCHOTT’s CERAN® glass-ceramic cooktop panels and tempered glass hobs for gas cookers for the Asian markets. CERAN® has become the world’s best-selling cooktop panel brand, and continuing innovations in material, applications, and design help it retain that leading position.
As a key manufacturing site for SCHOTT Pharma the plant also offers a broad choice of specifications in pharma drug containment and delivery solutions.

## About the region
### A developing city of commerce and beauty
The city of Suzhou (sometimes known as Soochow) is a major city in the Jiangsu Province of eastern China, located 100 km (62 miles) west of Shanghai. Given the continuing growth of both cities, their suburbs have actually begun to overlap. It is a major hub for trade and commerce in China, but also boasts a number of impressive cultural attractions. Often called the "Venice of the East", the city's canals, stone bridges, pagodas, and meticulously designed gardens attract many thousands of tourists every year, and the Classical Gardens of Suzhou are among UNESCO’s list of World Heritage Sites.

# SCHOTT MINIFAB Phoenix
In Phoenix, Arizona, SCHOTT MINIFAB specializes in the design and manufacture of microarrays using proprietary printing technology. Our expansive production facility enables us to deliver high-quality microarrays with unparalleled precision and high throughput.
## Advanced microarray technology
[SCHOTT MINIFAB](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/minifab) is a leading provider of contract development and manufacturing services for companies in the diagnostics and life science industries. Our team of experts has a deep understanding of the industry-specific challenges and offers innovative solutions that drive cost efficiencies and facilitate innovation. We specialize in streamlining the process from product development to pilot line to high-volume manufacturing of diagnostic or life science research consumables, with a focus on glass and polymer microfluidics and [microarrays](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/expertise/diagnostic-and-life-science-consumables/microarray-solutions).  
  
Located in Phoenix, our state-of-the-art facility offers advanced printing technology, unmatched capacity and flexibility to produce custom DNA and protein biosensors on glass, polymer, and silicon substrates for microarrays or microfluidics consumables. Our arrays are designed to meet even the most exacting standards, whether for research, diagnostics, or precision medicine. Our global integration of services enables us to provide a single-source contract development and manufacturing solution that is unique in the industry. This empowers product developers and researchers worldwide to realize innovations that improve patient care and advance scientific breakthroughs.

### Markets and applications
For over twenty years SCHOTT MINIFAB Phoenix has designed high-quality microarrays for a wide range of applications in biological and medical research. Providing insights into gene expression, genetic variations, protein profiling, drug discovery, pathogen detection, and small molecule arrays across various biological systems for diagnostics and life science industries.

### Services
We provide a full range of services to develop and manufacture high-quality customized microarrays for global customers. We offer a suite of microarray platforms to fulfill many life science industry segments.

## About the region
### Valley of the sun
The Grand Canyon State. Phoenix is the capital city of Arizona and is located in the central region of the state. Known for its year-round sun, desert beauty, and world-class resorts and golf, but as the fifth-largest city in the US, it also offers sophisticated urbanscapes, southwest culture, and lots of outdoor adventures. Phoenix’s nickname is Valley of the sun, the city is a desert metropolis with equal parts cacti, sandstone, historical sites, and modern architecture.   
  
Ranked 5th in the nation among Emerging Life Science Markets and 1st in Life Science Job Growth in 2020 and 2021 respectively, Phoenix is leading the way in the bioscience and biotechnology sectors. Becoming a magnet for innovators and industry leaders from all over the globe.

# SCHOTT Landshut
As the headquarters of the [Electronic Packaging](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/expertise/electronic-packaging) business unit, Landshut serves as a competence center for glass-metal bonding technology and an innovation center for specialty glass powders.
## Rooted locally. Connected internationally.
With two plants in Landshut, SCHOTT is one of the largest and most attractive employers in Lower Bavaria. The Landshut location stands out for its high level of innovation: Together with customers from around the world, we drive future technologies in various markets and applications, working on the continuous development of a wide range of specialty glass materials and components.
As an integral part of the global company network, SCHOTT Landshut fosters individual talent and accountability. Respect, fairness, and positive interaction are at the heart of our corporate culture.

## What we offer
### Markets and Applications
In Landshut, SCHOTT develops and manufactures [specialty glass powders](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/expertise/technology-and-processing/glass-powder-and-particle-technology) as well as a wide range of [glass-metal housings](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/expertise/technology-and-processing/glass-to-metal-sealing) that provide protection for sensitive electronics in various applications. Applications include high-speed data and telecommunications solutions, automotive, e-mobility, energy technology, dentistry, and cosmetics.
The versatility of glass-to-metal technology is further demonstrated by other applications such as [hydrogen](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/expertise/applications/hydrogen), batteries, implantable medical technology, or components for wearable devices.
![Server room](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/69cd37b7047443e6bdfee358e793e730?t=OnExW690)
### Products
The Electronic Packaging division consists of four product areas: Automotive, Industrial, Specialty Glass Powders, and Thermal Fuses. Within these areas, we develop and produce some of the most widely used glass components worldwide. Although these components often fulfill their tasks invisibly, they accompany us in everyday life in a multitude of safety-critical applications, from components for [airbags](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/products/feedthroughs-for-airbags-and-seatbelts-p1000277) and seat belts to protective devices for [lithium-ion batteries](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/products/lithium-ion-battery-fuses-and-switches-p1000285). Other products are being used in the [semiconductor industry](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/products/transistor-outline-packages-p1000294), in [smartwatches](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/products/schott-wearable-housing-components-p1001021) and wireless earbuds, in [liquefied natural gas](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/products/eternaloc-p1000276) applications, as well as in industrial [high-temperature sensing](https://www.schott.com/sitecore/service/notfound.aspx?item=web%3a%7bBC65CE44-1803-4A71-937E-FC5A07C7A224%7d%40en-GB) and [LiDAR](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/products/hermetic-packages-for-lidar-sensors-p1000281) sensors that are enabling autonomous vehicles.

##  About the region
### Unique character and charm
The historic town of Landshut is located about 60 kilometers from Munich, situated along the Isar River. With impressive Gothic architecture and winding alleys, the old town is known for its charm, small street cafés, and inviting restaurants. In Landshut, tradition meets modernity, and the town’s vibrancy can be felt throughout its many activities and events. Top attractions include the City Residence of Landshut; the Martinskirche, with the world's tallest brick tower; and the Trausnitz Castle, which dates to the Middle Ages and towers above the old town.

# SCHOTT Troisfontaines
SCHOTT VTF in Troisfontaines, France is part of the SCHOTT Flat Glass production network, which includes sites in Europe, South America, and Asia. Our focus is on innovations and new ideas for the home appliance industry.
## Locally rooted. Internationally networked
SCHOTT VTF is characterized by an exceptionally high level of innovative strength. Along with our customers worldwide, we drive forward future technologies in a wide variety of applications in home & living markets, working on the continuous development of flat glass printing and color technologies. As a central part of the SCHOTT global corporate network, SCHOTT VTF promotes individual talent and personal responsibility, with respect, fairness, and positive interaction with one another at the heart of our corporate culture.

## What we offer
### Markets and applications
Our focus is on innovations and ideas for the home appliance industry. We are known for pioneering new methods in glass processing and incredible printing and coating solutions. For example, our coating for gas hob tops makes cleaning 96% easier and requires no extra cleaning agents. We also have a range of highly distinctive design options for kitchens and bathrooms, and an extensive toolbox of colors for printing. Our customers rely on our high quality standards, which we maintain through rigorous testing procedures and precise processing methods.
![Modern kitchen interior black colors](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/03aa57fd559b40f0872450b5511ce0e7?t=OnExW690)
SCHOTT processes flat glass with a range of different edge designs 
### Products
Our products can be found wherever processed and special flat glass is used. That includes glasses for home and industrial appliances such as baking ovens and microwaves, as well as cooktop panels, control panels, extractor hoods, and refrigerator covers. We also process precision panels of all sizes, glasses for sanitary applications and displays, front glasses for kitchen appliances, and glasses for washing machines and dishwashers. There is simply no limit to our range of printed and coated glass panels.
![Colors on glass sheets](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/de17194788514bfbb210f705cdce25cd?t=OnExW690)
SCHOTT offers a wide range of design options for flat glass, including fine printing

## About the region
Troisfontaines is a small town in the Grand Est region of France. It is located in the picturesque valley of the Bièvre and surrounded by the gentle hills of the Vosges and acres of forest. The glass industry has been thriving in this region for centuries.

## 19th Otto Schott Research Award
The Otto Schott Research Award acknowledges exceptional scientific and technological achievements in the area of ground-breaking glass and materials science. Whether talented young scientists, seasoned researchers, or innovative thinkers: Let’s pave the way to a brighter future together.
## Award for pioneering glass research
In 2026, the Otto Schott Research Award was presented to Professor Steve Martin and Professor Kathleen Richardson for their pioneering contributions to the structure of glass as well as to optical and infrared materials. Their research provides key foundations for the development of high-performance specialty glass and opens up new possibilities for applications in fields such as energy, electronics, sensing, and healthcare.
![Steve Martin and Kathleen Richardson receive the Otto Schott Research Award](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/1fcc781f196d4dd0b751131e02d26d5a?t=OnExW690)
Steve Martin and Kathleen Richardson receive the Otto Schott Research Award. Picture: SCHOTT 
## About the award 
Innovation is in our DNA. So, every two years, excellent researchers are honored with the Otto Schott Research Award for their scientific and technological achievements in basic and applied research in the fields of glass, glass-ceramics or related special materials. The Ernst Abbe Fonds is granting the award, that has been set up by the Carl-Zeiss-Foundation together with SCHOTT and ZEISS. First presented in 1991, it recognizes outstanding scientific achievements in fundamental research and technology development of special materials, components, and systems for applications like optics and electronics, solar power, health, and living. It is also intended to encourage support for collaboration between science and industry. The Stifterverband für die Deutsche Wissenschaft manages the Ernst Abbe Fonds, which is responsible for funding the endowment of 25,000 €. Past winners include experts from fields like physics and chemistry representing nations such as the United States, Japan, China, Germany, and various European countries. It is named after the founder of the SCHOTT AG Otto Schott, who is considered the inventor of modern glass technology. Borosilicate glass, one of his many inventions, has changed the world. Unlike any other invention, these products have influenced and, in some cases, even enabled the development of optics, the large-scale chemical industry, and people's everyday lives all over the world.
![glass cubes](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/21bb280f3b7547f2a54fba462edac4ad?t=OnExW690)
## About the application and upcoming award ceremony
### Application
If you are a scientist or leading researcher and have an interesting scientific or technological achievement in one of the following fields (glass, glass-ceramics and related advanced materials), please do not hesitate to learn more about the next call for applications: [Home | Otto Schott Research Award](https://otto-schott-research-award.de/).
![Icon of a contract and pen](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/5141f463179549e4897482b1f6441d4b?t=OnExW185)
### Application criteria
Central criteria for the awarding of the prize are the candidate´s scientific activity in recent years, the quality and originality of his/her original scientific publications, and the extent how he/she has influenced the research field.
![Icon of a checklist](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/8c3bad1aadf544a5b480d10b4b9603dc?t=OnExW185)
### Award Ceremony 2026
The OSA 2026 was presented during the annual meeting of the ICG on 13 April 2026 in Lyon.
![Icon of a trophy](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/0c71ca459b84425abbbdec0af9aebcfb?t=OnExW185)

# Sustainability
The guiding principle of sustainability is deeply rooted in SCHOTT’s company history. It stems from our unique corporate model and has its roots in the Foundation Statute from 1896. Responsible corporate governance, responsibility for employees and society, as well as the environment and the climate are the core elements of our sustainability strategy.  

## Our Responsibility
![Worker in production checking the Furnace](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/c8e7bc78d631467ca59ed6db5262c95e?t=OnExW720)
## Environmental Responsibility
Environmental protection has been one of SCHOTT's key corporate goals for decades. Time and again, we have set new sustainability standards in the glass industry, and we want to do the same when it comes to protecting the climate. As a globally operating group, we want to actively contribute, and reduce the CO2 emissions in our production step by step. 
[Learn more](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/sustainability/environmental-responsibility)
![Kids running](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/04b4f4ca9f1e4c05a2ce091cd16bdef2?t=OnExW720)
## Social Responsibility
One of the fundamental ideas of our owner, the Carl Zeiss Foundation, is the special responsibility we have for employees and society. Health, safety and social security have top priority for us. However, our responsibility does not end at the factory gates. That is why we are also committed to the community around our locations around the world. 
[Learn more](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/sustainability/social-responsibility)
![Women and Man standing on a whiteboard](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/85c6bbce4b9943c4a9dc19477fef975a?t=OnExW720)
## Economic responsibility
As a foundation company, sustainable action and business development are firmly linked for us because we are already thinking about tomorrow today. With our products, we want to positively contribute to society and act responsibly in economic terms. For us, this means combining social responsibility, environmental protection, and profitable growth.
[Learn more](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/sustainability/economic-responsibility)
![Woman and Man working together on a laptop](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/43b3a1b50eb34961be7804091dd206a2?t=OnExW720)
## Compliance
Compliance means more to us than just adhering to the rules and regulations of each country we operate in. Building and maintaining the trust of our employees and business partners in our company and products is our most valuable asset. 
[Learn more](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/sustainability/compliance)
![Text Image Slider-07](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/943b91897512458480db450129f737d2)
### Innovation drives the future 
SCHOTT won the 2024 New Gases Innovation Award in the Application Technology category. Our "100% Hydrogen in Glass Production" project demonstrates that replacing fossil fuels with hydrogen in industrial-scale glass manufacturing is technically feasible. However, achieving this transition requires hydrogen at competitive prices and a well-developed infrastructure. 
![Text Image Slider-09](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/19a68a65c5034051a9fd25d11df6412d?v=991a50bb)
### Innovative hydrogen project 
SCHOTT received the 2025 SPIE Catalyst Award for developing innovative solutions in specialty glass manufacturing. The project, "Production of Optical Glass Using 100% Hydrogen," demonstrated that specialty glass can be produced entirely with hydrogen without compromising quality. This achievement underscores that decarbonizing glass production is not only essential but also technically feasible. Widespread adoption, however, will require a reliable hydrogen supply and supportive economic conditions.
![Text Image Slider-10](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/26d852d4da0c475db4f4deaacfdaf315?v=57ae2cff)
### Top 3 for process heat recovery
For our commitment to advancing the industrial energy transition, we were recognized by the German Energy Agency (dena) in 2025. Our “Process Waste Heat Recovery – Main Plant Mainz” project ranked among the top three entries in the category “From clever to digital! – The full spectrum of energy efficiency” at the Energy Efficiency Award 2025.
![Text Image Slider-11](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/7463d2d93be84bfda2163ee3ebd5fc97?v=5946bb92)
### Recognized network engagement
In 2025, the Effinet@SCHOTT 3.0 project was recognized for its commitment to energy efficiency as part of the federal government and trade associations' Energy Efficiency and Climate Protection Networks initiative. 
During the two-year project period, participating SCHOTT sites saved approximately 42,000 megawatt hours (MWh) of energy, €3.4 million in energy costs, and over 11,000 tons of CO₂ equivalents. 
[More information](https://www.effizienznetzwerke.org/the-networks-initiative/)
![Text Image Slider-08](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/02fe17f022224f1b80646bed2e47a5e1)
### Outstanding Value Chain Initiative
In 2024, SCHOTT received the Sustainability Championship Award from the Berlin Institute Supply Chain Management for its value chain initiatives. The program focused on collaborating with suppliers to optimize processes and identify opportunities for CO₂ emissions reduction.
![Text Image Slider-01](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/c1c1984b6ace4d24af2a53a7287435e3?v=e3b567b0)
### Silver Rating for Sustainability
In 2025, the international sustainability rating agency EcoVadis awarded SCHOTT a Silver rating. With a score of 75 out of 100, SCHOTT ranks among the top 8% of companies assessed worldwide, placing us in the leading group within the glass industry. The EcoVadis rating strengthens transparency and trust in our collaboration with business partners and underlines our commitment to continuously improving our performance.
[More information](https://recognition.ecovadis.com/_1SqQc-1FE6q693e0iSjAg)
![Text Image Slider-06](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/c0c19a6b337444d9849a522a88c73205)
### Scientifically based climate targets
As a research-driven technology group, a scientific approach to climate protection is vital to us. We have therefore joined the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). The independent review confirmed that our targets align with the latest climate science. 
![Text Image Slider-02](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/bc4b981b1de04d6fa1725f1c31eace75)
### Sustainable business practices for the benefit of all
We are clearly committed to human rights, fair working conditions, and environmental and climate protection. At the same time, we oppose corruption and bribery. We are a participant of the UN Global Compact network. We thus support the world’s largest and most important initiative for sustainable and responsible corporate governance.
![Text Image Slider-04](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/8f4eda6bfe994ff0b20fe2b48d1f0da3)
### For more diversity in the workplace
Diversity is an opportunity. By signing the Charter of Diversity, we are sending a clear signal in favor of diversity and tolerance. In doing so, we show our appreciation for all our employees. We are committed to equal opportunities and a working world without prejudice, because this is the only way we can promote everyone’s potential.

# About us
From our unique company structure and pioneering spirit to our culture of innovation and sustainability strategy, the people at SCHOTT are constantly pushing the boundaries of glass and material development to achieve groundbreaking scientific and technological progress. Together we strive to make a difference for businesses, industries and people.
![SCHOTT engineer wearing heat-resistant clothing at a production facility](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/8894cc21776a46f988cac5243ed32204?t=OnExW720)
## The SCHOTT Group
SCHOTT has risen from a small glassworks in Germany to one of the leading specialty glass and material technology companies in the world. Today, more than 17.400 highly skilled employees in over 30 countries around the globe are dedicated to turn bold ideas into reality.
[Discover more](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/company)
![Bridge in forest](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/53d8c54c377e4dff8269ad8dacd92454?t=OnExW720)
## Sustainability
The guiding principles of sustainability are deeply anchored at SCHOTT. It comes from our unique corporate model and has its roots in the foundation statute of 1896. Responsible governance, responsibility for employees, society, environment and the climate are key elements of our sustainability strategy.
[Learn more](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/sustainability)
![Cobot positioning a Glaswafer into a laser processing machine](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/7786b4681ac34aa792d55b505d5aa538?t=OnExW720)
## Projects and references
From protecting ancient manuscripts to expanding our knowledge of the universe: SCHOTT has a long history of working with world’s leading specialists, using our expertise in glass and material technology to solve complex challenges.
[Find out more](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/references)
![Three men in a conference room engaged in a collaborative working session](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/16cc801f63214e75938718bf1f583441?t=OnExW720)
## Certifications and compliance documents
We work in a highly regulated industry in a large number of locations around the world, and strictly adhere to all safety, quality, and sustainability standards. All certificates demonstrating these standards, as well as company, location, and application documents, are available to download.
[Search documents](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/certifications-and-compliance-document-search)

# The SCHOTT Group
As a leading global manufacturer of specialty glass, glass-ceramics, and other advanced materials, it is our goal to create life-changing innovations for a better future. Our success comes from the expertise and experience of our employees and partners around the world.
![SCHOTT blue abstract keyvisual](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/06033c18416342a5a7ccbabe4bf24bd4?t=OnExW690)
### Our purpose
Where others say no, we say yes. Because at SCHOTT we believe that shared responsibility can achieve the impossible. We are constantly exploring unique and innovative ways to make a difference for businesses, industries and people.
[ Discover more ](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/company/our-purpose)
![Stacked transparent glass-ceramic panels ready for packaging](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/645905c9843c4491a448878255875460?t=OnExW690)
### Annual Report
From our key financial results and production statistics to the number of patents we hold and different nationalities we employ: Learn more about SCHOTT by discovering some facts and figures.
[ Find out more ](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/company/annual-report)
![Group Picture SCHOTT Management Board. From left to right: Dr. Andrea Frenzel, CFO Marcus Knöbel, CEO Dr. Torsten Derr and Dr. Heinz Kaiser](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/0b9ada46816240a0a57c0cce5f3bb283?t=OnExW720)
## SCHOTT Management
The SCHOTT Management Board comprises four experts. Alongside the 12-member Supervisory Board, they are all committed to the guiding principles of “Pioneering. Responsibly. Together”.
[Find out more](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/company/management)
History
## SCHOTT has been re-inventing glass for over 140 years
[Dive into our history](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/company/history "Dive into our history")
![Ceremony for the 125th anniversary of the Carl Zeiss Foundation addressed by Chancellor Angela Merkel](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/6989486f917c400a8406e99bf3b237f7?t=OnExW720)
## Carl Zeiss Foundation
SCHOTT’s corporate model was formed over 100 years ago, and is designed to secure the long-term future of the two foundation companies and the promotion of science. The organization is now one of Germany’s largest private foundations.
[Find out more](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/company/carl-zeiss-foundation)
![Female looking at illuminated lines on glass panel ](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/1bdb15d274624034a0affa713daebe38?t=OnExW720)
## Research and Development
Over 140 years of experience in creating groundbreaking glass solutions evolved into a commitment to material innovation. Discover how we use our unique skill-set and the latest technology to set new standards in a wide range of industries.
[Discover more](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/company/research-and-development)
![Globe at night with shining lights](https://media.schott.com/api/public/content/56b34ec1649744b1a50d7ca92541b1a2?t=OnExW720)
## Regions and Locations
From Europe and the US, across Asia and South America, SCHOTT has production sites and sales offices in 33 countries around the globe. This vast international presence gives us a valuable global outlook and a worldwide network of experts.
[Find out more](https://www.schott.com/en-gb/about-us/company/regions-and-locations)

# Annual report
At SCHOTT, progress is driven by shared responsibility, deep expertise, and close collaboration. These values shape not only how we work internally, but also how we partner with customers around the world. As an international technology group for advanced materials such as specialty glass, glass-ceramics, and polymers, we develop solutions that create lasting value for businesses and industries – yesterday, today, and tomorrow.  
  
Many of our products enable high-tech applications at the forefront of innovation, including waveguides for augmented reality smart glasses, glass-ceramic mirror substrates for the world's largest telescopes, and laser glass used in nuclear fusion research. With 17,400 experts working in more than 30 countries, SCHOTT combines scientific excellence with practical partnership to support a broad spectrum of industries.
## Powered by people
Across the globe, SCHOTT's employees combine pioneering spirit with deep technical expertise to support industries such as healthcare, home appliances, consumer electronics, semiconductors, optics, astronomy, energy, and aerospace. Their commitment and know-how ensure that our innovations translate into real value for the industries we serve.

SCHOTT Board of Management (from L to R): Dr. Heinz Kaiser, Dr. Torsten Derr (CEO), Dr. Andrea Frenzel, Marcus Knöbel
## Financials
The 2024/2025 fiscal year once again presented a complex mix of macroeconomic headwinds and important progress for SCHOTT. Amid ongoing economic stagnation in Germany, structural uncertainties in global markets, and persistently elevated costs — particularly energy and industrial-input costs — the Group nonetheless delivered stable financial performance. This outcome reflects the strength of SCHOTT’s long-term investment and growth strategy, combined with disciplined cost and risk management. Looking ahead, we remain committed to advancing our strategic agenda and will continue to invest in our future.
